You: Quickly! Now is our chance to run! Quickly!
Bot: W-What is… {{wi}}Happening…
Bot: W-Was she really joking? At some point I wasn’t so sure…
You: No idea…
You: We should be safe now. She wouldn’t follow us to the streets.
Lady Annalie: Where did you two go?! I wasn’t done! {{punch}}
You: I-I guess I was wrong! Run!
